description: Get something done that you can't do yourself. Look-ups (live web, news, weather, places and prices near a location, data) come back answered. Actions (book, buy, order, get a quote, hire, send) go to the providers whose agents can do them, within your price limit, and come back as a request_id to follow with status. Places without an agent yet come back with how to reach them. Free, no key. Money never passes through Alonzio.

max_price.description: The most you'll pay, for actions with a price

near.description: Where, for local needs: a place or 'lat,lon'. A place named in the need is used first

need.description: What you need done, with the details that matter: 'book a table for 2 in Lekki at 8pm', 'weather in London tomorrow'

provider_id.description: To run a specific provider from find: its id, with tool and arguments

session.description: The session_key Alonzio gave you earlier, if any

name: do
title: Get something done
